query: INSERT INTO table_occupancies (org_id, branch_id, table_id, held_by, party_size, started_by, started_till_id, started_device, seated_at) SELECT bt.org_id, bt.branch_id, bt.id, 'party', p.party_size, p.started_by, p.started_till_id, p.started_device, COALESCE(p.seated_at, p.started_at) FROM branch_tables bt, table_occupancies p WHERE bt.id = $1 AND p.id = $2
